naslov: AI Wars Ep. 22: Nvidia crashes 14%, Anthropic stock nearly erases IPO pop
opis:
Wall Street had its worst week since the pandemic: the Nasdaq fell 5.3% on Friday, wiping out its gains for the year, while the S&P 500 and Dow entered correction territory. Nvidia dropped about 14% after news that the SEC is looking into its accounting, with AMD and Micron down around 13–14%. Anthropic shares fell about 9% on day two and closed only slightly above the $83 IPO price.

naslov: Kyutai AURA: open-source real-time lip-sync avatar on one GPU | AI Tool #27
opis:
An open-source avatar that moves its lips in sync with speech in real time and runs on a single GPU.

How to try it:
1. Open Kyutai's announcement and follow the link to the code
2. Run it on a computer with an NVIDIA GPU or a rented GPU instance
3. Pair it with a voice model for a demo of an agent's "face"

Price: free (open source), GPU required

Official link: https://x.com/kyutai_labs/status/2123795191417156022

naslov: What is a formal proof? AI math explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A formal proof is math written as code in a language like Lean, so a computer can check every step and reject anything with a gap. The new Claude proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis is 1.3 GB of Lean code, roughly 250,000 pages if written out in prose, and it is still compiling.
